newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Several thousand ANZ staff strike in NZ over pay.
newsitem.headline: Several thousand ANZ staff strike in NZ over pay.

text.p: Several thousand staff of ANZ Banking Group (New Zealand) Ltd went on strike on Friday over a pay dispute, the Finsec trade union said.
General Secretary Paul Goulter said the strike was expected to be for just one day except in Wellington, where workers voted to strike again on Monday.
The union seeks a six percent pay rise, while the bank is offering 3.5 percent. Some branches were closed by the strike, while others remained open for limited business.
ANZ's general manager of personnel, Julie McDougall, said the bank remained firm on its offer, which was "fair and reasonable" in the New Zealand marketplace.
The bank is part of Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd.
